title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode1 Proof Of Musicianship

meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka
se_event_faith_2022_001
se_event_faith_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No matter how many times I listen to Saki's song, I never get tired of it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It does such a great job of drawing you into its world and conveying Saki's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With this song...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
I know. How about that other band?
They're called... I forgot their name, but they mentioned that they want to debut with a big label...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: You should be able to see them perform if you really wish. Their music has that cute, mainstream pop sound you're after and they even look the part. A band made up of high school girls through and through.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Honestly, you'll probably have better luck with them than us.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Oh, now I remember.
They're called Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're not just trying to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With this song... The song that Saki wrote... We're gonna show everyone that our goal is to play music that moves people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We have one month until our next show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We need to get this song perfect by then.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're gonna have to practice harder than ever before, and figure out how to actually go about that...
bgm_area00001
The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, we finally get to start practicing for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm ready for whatever! Bring it on!
I'm gonna blow everyone away by playing outta this world!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. You sound so stoked, Sakki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because our newest song is my absolutely, unequivocally, categorically the best thing I've ever written!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it's only become better after working on the arrangement for it with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, it's become a more technically challenging song than what we're used to playing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all, Shiho, you did do everything you could to make it so this song clearly conveys Saki's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing how the audience reacts when they hear this song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Also, how are the lyrics coming along?
You're writing them, right, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I was gonna ask the same thing!
How's it going, Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I finished writing them yesterday and was hoping to hear you guys' opinions.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it did take me a little while to write them since I wanted to cover everything that you were trying to convey in your song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, this might work.
I'll type these lyrics in and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, this still isn't right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It becomes so obvious when I get Miku to sing using my lyrics. They just aren't getting Saki's thoughts and feelings across...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki wrote, “It hurts,” and “I hate this so much,” in her songwriting notebook. She even had, “I don't want tomorrow to come”...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All these things that I can't imagine her saying. And they were scrawled with so much pain that you could feel it just from looking.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She was carrying all this pain and all these memories that I didn't know about...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But she said the message I sent helped her get through that, even though my original intention was to chat for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, these lyrics won't do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All I did was just wrote down Saki's words and arranged them to the melody of the song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means there's no point in me writing these lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I have to use my own words.
I need to take her feelings from this song and tell everyone what's really going on...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It wasn't easy, but I managed to finish them, and I really like how they turned out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you must've written some great lyrics if you put so much thought into them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mind showing us what you wrote...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. It's always a little nerve-wracking showing others my lyrics, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here they are...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
You used very straightforward language like you usually do, Ichika, but I feel my chest tightening with each passing word...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So much pain and loneliness...
But you can see the light at the end of the tunnel. There's also this sort of warmth that's pushing you along.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're incredible, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A lot of words and thoughts came to mind as I wrote my song, but I couldn't string them together very well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The lyrics you wrote make so much sense. It's like you knew exactly what I was thinking.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Not only that, your lyrics helped turn my song into our song. Leo/need's song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I'm really, really glad that you were the one who wrote the lyrics for us again this time, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It makes me happy to hear that.
And thank you for telling me about what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Saki's masterpiece coupled with Ichika's beautiful lyrics means this song's become something quite special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it has.
I'm very much looking forward to playing it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
I can't wait to practice it and play it in front of people!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Before we start practicing, there's something I need to tell all of you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...
“A band made up of high school girls through and through.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is that how people see us...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we've been telling others that we're trying to go pro, but that's not exactly the image we were going for...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we can't really control what others think...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our performances still need work, and our songs didn't resonate with that crowd during our last show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, it wasn't just the crowd...
Saku didn't really feel anything after hearing us play.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I wanna show everyone what we're really made of at our next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's like what Shiho told Saku...
I want our music to do the talking for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, we worked super duper hard on our latest song just for the crowd at that live house... And it turned out this well because we put a ton of thought into it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, I'm really confident about it!
I'm sure everyone at that live house...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone who hears this song is gonna be blown away by it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saku said that we're “a band made up of high school girls through and through” because our music didn't strike a chord with her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
However, with Saki's new song...
I'm sure that audience, as well as Saku, will understand what Leo/need's all about.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I'm also going to do everything I can for our next show. I want to prove to everyone that we're not going pro just for fun...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sounds like you're all in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But Shih, you really put yourself out there by saying that you girls are gonna show everyone what this band's all about with your music!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, but I don't regret saying that.
I couldn't stay silent while someone trashed Leo/need behind our backs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you didn't speak up, Shiho, I probably would've said something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Atta girl.
I like your moxie.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too.
And we're behind you all the way until your next show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, that means we've really gotta practice...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This song has a different melody and tempo compared to what we usually play, so we may want to start by individually mastering how to play it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
If I'm gonna be honest, at our current level, I'm not sure a month is gonna be enough for us to get it perfect.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I came up with practice schedules that should allow us to efficiently make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, for all of us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, here.
I made copies for all of us, so if you don't mind taking a look.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! Way to go, Shih! You're always so reliable!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Impressive...
This clearly details what each of you will need to do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If we can get through this, we should be able to put on a perfect show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does!
This looks really hard at first glance, but I think we'll do just fine as long as we try together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree...!
I'd like to give it a try as well!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's all do our best until our next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Again, a month probably isn't enough time for us to play this song in a way that really moves everyone in that crowd.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But I'm not backing down.
Not after what we were told that time...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do absolutely everything I can until the day of our show. I have to support everyone somehow...)
